name: Threats
overview: Scripture reveals that threats often arise from disobedience and idolatry, leading to conflict and divine discipline, as seen when Israel's turning to new gods brought war to their gates (Judges 5:8). God promises blessing and exaltation to those who diligently obey His commandments, yet warns of consequences for serving Him without joy and faithfulness (Deuteronomy 28:1, 28:47). In the midst of threats, God is our refuge and strength, empowering His people to stand firm and fight with His strength and guidance (Psalms 46:1; 144:1). Even theft and violence demand just restitution, underscoring God's righteous order amid human threats (Exodus 22:1).
